title: Construction Fees Cut 50% Until 31 Dec 2026: Which Are Reduced?
desc: Circular 64/2025/TT-BTC halves fees for project, design and estimate appraisal, fire safety, construction certificates and business registration to 31 Dec 2026.
summary: The list of construction, fire safety and document fees and charges reduced by 50% under Circular 64/2025/TT-BTC, applicable only until 31 December 2026.
body: To support citizens and businesses, the Ministry of Finance issued Circular 64/2025/TT-BTC, reducing the rates of many fees and charges. The reduction applies only from 1 July 2025 to 31 December 2026; from 1 January 2027, rates return to those under the original circulars (Clauses 1 and 2, Article 1; Article 4). Below are the items related to building a house or carrying out a project.
1. Project, design and estimate appraisal fees: reduced 50%
Appraisal fee for construction investment projects (Feasibility Study Report or Economic-Technical Report): 50% of the rate in Circular 28/2023/TT-BTC (item no. 33).
Technical design appraisal fee (detailed design after basic design) and construction estimate appraisal fee: 50% of the rate in Circular 27/2023/TT-BTC (item no. 32).
These fees are paid by the investor when receiving the appraisal result (Article 2 of Circular 27/2023/TT-BTC; Article 2 of Circular 28/2023/TT-BTC).

Fee for appraising and approving the fire safety design: 50% (item no. 12). The original Circular 258/2016/TT-BTC has been replaced by Circular 70/2025/TT-BTC; under Point b, Clause 1, Article 1, when the original circular is replaced, the reduction rate is applied to the rate in the new document.
Fee for inspecting fire safety equipment: 50% (item no. 22).
For which works must have their fire safety design appraised, see Fire safety design appraisal 2026.

Fee for issuing construction activity capacity certificates for organizations and construction practice certificates for individuals: 50% (item no. 31). Note: from 1 July 2026, the Construction Law 2025 requires practice certificates only for individuals holding certain positions; organizations switch to self-publishing their capacity on the website of the Ministry of Construction (Clauses 1 and 6, Article 88).
Business registration fee (new issuance, reissuance, changes to business registration contents, branches, representative offices, business locations): 50% (item no. 45).
Enterprises established within 12 months and business households registering their first "biz.vn" domain name: the fee is paid from the 3rd year (Article 3).
Fee for exchanging or reissuing citizen identity cards: 50% (item no. 19).
Fee for retrieving information from the National Population Database: 50% (item no. 46) - a fee that may arise when a notary retrieves data in place of documents.
The reduction also applies when procedures are done through online public services (Point c, Clause 1, Article 1).
5. Items not on the reduction list

The fee schedule of Circular 64/2025/TT-BTC does not include the land and house registration fee or the notarization fee for sale contracts, so these are still collected under their own rules (the land and house registration fee remains 0.5% under Article 8 of Consolidated Document 33/VBHN-BTC). See Land and house registration fee 2026.

The circular is in force only from 1 July 2025 to 31 December 2026 (Article 4). Design, estimate and project appraisal fees are paid by the investor when receiving the appraisal result, so applications whose results are received from 1 January 2027 may no longer be reduced. If you are preparing an application, submit early and ask the fee-collecting authority beforehand about the applicable rate. Other matters such as the payer, exempt cases and how to declare still follow the original circulars (Clause 3, Article 1).

This article is only a summary for reference and does not replace the legal documents. Circular 64/2025/TT-BTC is in force only until 31 December 2026 and is shown as partly no longer in force; some original circulars (such as Circular 38/2022/TT-BTC on certificate fees) are not in our legal library. The specific amount is notified by the fee-collecting authority.
